patterns.message: const only: no let, no mutation
no else branches: use expression lookups or pattern-matched returns
errors are values internally; typed errors only at the outermost edge
use ?? for absence: || swallows valid falsy values
use map/filter/reduce pipelines over loops; repeat effects by recursion (return the same effect again)
no array mutation: use spread and pure transformations
no object mutation: partial updates travel as patch objects
no non-null assertions: fall back to a named value with ?? or model absence as Option
inject effects as capabilities (Console, Clock, Random); ambient effects only in edge interpreters (fp-allow there)
fold from the monoid identity: reduce(concat, empty) — a seedless reduce throws on []
